eyebrow: fetch() doesn't reject on a 404 or 500
caption: fetch() only rejects on network failure. Check response.ok yourself — a 404 still 'succeeds' as far as fetch is concerned.
async/await for flow, try/catch for failure, response.ok checked by hand — every lesson in this chapter, in one function.
The caller never needs to know fetch, response bodies, or rejections were involved at all.
